We are seeking a driven, resourceful, and highly adaptable Project Manager (PM) to lead the operations of a fast-paced, geographically dispersed research center dedicated to advancing open scientific computing and data science infrastructure. The ideal candidate is a go-getter who stays on top of multiple priorities, keeps things moving smoothly, and can wear many hats — from managing logistics to engaging with diverse teams across academic institutions and research partners. This role requires someone who is action-oriented and thrives in a high-energy, deadline-driven environment where the ability to manage competing priorities and shift focus quickly is essential to success.

This is a mission-driven role suited for a professional who thrives at the intersection of research, technology, and community engagement — someone who can manage complexity, foster cross-institutional relationships, and keep distributed teams aligned and moving forward.

The PM will function as the operational backbone of the Center, working closely with the Principal Investigator (PI), research partners, stakeholders, and technical staff to ensure the seamless execution of the Center's activities and strategic goals. They will be supported by a project coordinator role.
Thorough knowledge of administrative, budgetary, human resources and financial principles and practices.
Strong oral and written communication skills.
Strong ability to think creatively and independently on concepts requiring advanced analytical skills.
Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work with diverse groups to achieve results.
Strong ability to work collaboratively with internal and external peers and managers.
